SSC JHT Junior Hindi Translator Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

SSC JHT Junior Hindi Translator Admit Card 2026. Candidates can now download their admit card / hall ticket from the official website before the exam date. The last date to apply is 14/05/2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Start Date : 23/04/2026
  • Last Date : 14/05/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 15/05/2026
  • Correction Date : 19-20 May 2026
  • Admit Card Released Date : As Per Schedule
  • Exam Date : 08/09/2026
  • Result Declared Date : As Per Schedule
  • Download Admit Card : Click Here
  • How to Check Exam City (Video Hindi) : Click Here
  • Download Exam City Notice : Click Here
  • Download Admit Card : Link will be Activate Soon
  • Download Exam Date Notice : Click Here

Application Fee

  • Start Date : 23/04/2026
  • Last Date : 14/05/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 15/05/2026
  • General / OBC / EWS : Rs. 100/-
  • SC / ST / PH : Rs. 0/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
